findings: no_introduce_species short only prohibits exotic species while variants and several examples extend to all native replanting without supporting evidence. Narrow examples/variants or obtain direct official support.

stay_on_routes, leave_no_waste and leave_natural_objects are reasonable editorial conservation advice but the supplied evidence does not directly establish legal prohibitions. Keep recommendations clearly phrased and find direct official visitor rules when available.

audiovisual_permits and commercial_photography may overlap; preserve distinction between video authorization and commercial photography only if source wording supports it; do not require permits for every casual visitor video.
Research gap is disproportionate for core rules (fire, feeding wildlife, drones, noise). Seek a park regulation or general national parks regulation before accepting all as unresolved.
